review.why: Turns resume duties into truthful impact bullets by asking for real evidence, keeping estimates and never inventing numbers.
review.summary: Chooses a pace (one bullet, fast path, full mining), triages bullets, mines achievements with questions, sizes each result and checks source, credit, other causes and confidentiality. Each fact is tagged stated, estimate, document, calculated or inferred, and an inferred one never reaches a bullet. Drafts use four forms and a lint; resume edits need approval.
strengths: A derived number needs the user's yes, and placeholders block delivery
Defensibility test: could the user explain the figure in an interview
Myths table debunks common resume statistics
cautions: Very long, and six reference files are not read here
Questions come first, so it is slower than a plain rewrite by design
The patching section applies only when the builder's tools are connected
